payload.title: Preserve evidence rank across optimization policy gates
payload.description:
As an operator, I want every quantified optimization opportunity to retain its original evidence rank while policy gates determine whether it is selected, so that deferred work remains visible, explainable, and monitorable.

Feature: Evidence rank and action disposition

Scenario: Recent activity defers a high-ranked score
Given a score has a high reviewed-error opportunity
And recent score activity places it in cooldown
When the portfolio is ranked and candidates are selected
Then its evidence rank remains unchanged in the complete opportunity order
And its action disposition is deferred with the cooldown reason and eligibility time
And it is not dispatched for optimization

Scenario: Top-K selection follows policy gates
Given quantified opportunities have complete evidence ranks
When structural and activity gates are applied
Then up to K eligible scores receive a selected disposition
And eligible scores below the budget remain visible with a below-current-selection disposition
And no policy gate silently renumbers the evidence rank

Scenario: Operator reviews the opportunity distribution
Given the living Report contains quantified opportunities with mixed dispositions
When the overview is rendered
Then a shared-scale opportunity curve shows their relative magnitudes
And selected, cooldown, blocked, and below-selection scores have distinct labeled marks
And the detailed list retains the evidence rank, quantified value, disposition, reason, and resource links

Scenario: Evidence is incomplete
Given ranking or policy evidence is incomplete
When the Report is published
Then affected scores remain visible with an incomplete disposition
And the Report does not claim an exact selection cutoff.
